messages:
sam (ceo): Quick follow-up from AH Q&A: people asked for a concise summary of why we won or lost deals this quarter and concrete next steps. I'll start: top loss themes were pilot speed, named support, and perf guarantees. Wins were strong observability and clear cost breakdowns.

anya (product): Can we make this actionable for Sales? My proposal: 1) a 1-page 'win/loss' cheat sheet for reps, 2) a pilot fast-path checklist + named-POC SLA, 3) a tiny per-tenant eval snapshot for demos.

julia (sales): Yes please. Sales needs the cheat sheet and an elevator script (<30s) they can use on calls. Also a template email for committing a pilot timeline.

eli (cs): CS will own the named-POC SLA wording and the pilot handoff checklist. I'll pair with Maya for an onboarding playbook. ETA: 5 business days for drafts.

omar (eng-sre): For perf guarantees we can offer a 'pilot perf-run' (load script + dashboard) that customers run with our SRE. I'll produce the script and a short runbook. ETA: 4 days.

maya (eng-infra): I can produce a minimal on-prem image + Terraform module for pilots. If we scope it minimal it's 8 business days; full audited image is longer.

anya (product): Product will reprioritize a tiny per-tenant eval view as a 2-sprint canary. I'll also write the 1-pager copy for Sales (3 bullets why customers choose Redwood).

sam (ceo): Good. Let's capture owners & deadlines in a short sync. Ops-bot, please create a 30-min follow-up.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Customer Win/Loss Rapid Sync"  Wed 10:30  Attendees: Sam, Anya, Julia, Eli, Maya, Omar.

julia (sales): I'll compile a list of 6 recent prospects that raised these concerns and post to #sales-playbooks before the sync.

eli (cs): After the sync CS will publish the pilot checklist and SLA template to the playbooks folder and ping #customer-success.

anya (product): Thanks all. If anyone has customer quotes or notes, drop them here so Nora/Research can include them in the playbook doc. We'll aim to have first drafts before the sync.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands live Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
